assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided — required for dosing and safety of metformin, ACE‑I/ARB, SGLT2‑i, spironolactone, and lithium (NICE NG136).
Serum potassium not provided — needed before initiating ACE‑I/ARB or mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (NICE NG136).
Blood pressure reading not provided — required to determine need for antihypertensive therapy (NICE NG136).
QRISK or 10‑year CVD risk score not provided — needed to decide on statin therapy for primary prevention (NICE CG181).
Current medication list (prescription, OTC, supplements) not provided — cannot verify drug‑drug interactions or identify already prescribed guideline‑recommended agents.
Allergy status not provided — cannot confirm safety of ACE‑I, ARB, statins, sulfonamide‑containing drugs, etc.
treatment_summary: Insufficient patient-specific data (eGFR, serum potassium, blood pressure, cardiovascular risk, current medications, and allergy status) to generate a definitive NICE‑compliant medication regimen. Once these data are obtained, appropriate first‑line agents (e.g., ACE‑I/ARB, metformin, statin, SGLT2‑i, beta‑blocker, etc.) can be prescribed with exact doses, titration schedules, duration, and monitoring per the relevant NICE guidelines.
